Method of Attack: Downloading VBScript from paste sites that connect to C&C servers and gain persistence by setting up local folders and registry keys
Ransomware deployment and source code modification
VBScript hosted on Pastebin that installs njRAT and downloads encrypted RAT strings from HasteBin
Impacted Systems: Windows systems infected by VBScript-based RATs and ransomware
Attack Vector: Distribution of VBScript RAT via PasteBin and other paste sites
Use of dynamic DNS subdomains and a registered domain (microsofit.net) for C&C servers
Social media and paste sites for malware promotion and distribution
Indicators of Compromise: C&C servers on 105 dynamic DNS subdomains (e.g., mohammadx47.ddns.net, mohamedsaeed.ddns.net)
VBScript files posted on paste sites in spikes during August 2016, October 2016, and March 2017
YouTube and Facebook posts related to MoWare H.F.D ransomware
